nodes.long_description:
The ultimate darts simulation, featuring Meta Avatars and Multiplayer. 6 game modes including Cricket, along with 5 AAA quality rooms to play in. Experience the pinpoint accuracy of Quest while challenging your friends online in games of 501, 301, Cricket and Freethrow.

Show off your fully customized darts by choosing from dozens of tips, barrels, shafts and flights. Create hundreds of combinations in our Dart Customization menu.

Single Player mode includes Cricket, 501, 301, and Around the world, all vs AI, as well as Freethrow and Speed Darts modes to get you warmed up. Gain achievements, and challenge players from around the world for top spot on one of our many Leaderboards.

Play in one of five beautifully rendered AAA quality scenes including the Black Hat Tavern, the Tournament Arena, Basement Rec Room, and a Brutalist Default Room that also has a Glow in the Dark theme.

See you in the Tavern!
nodes.short_description:
Dive into the ultimate darts simulation on Quest, featuring Meta Avatars and an overhauled multiplayer system. 

Enjoy six different game modes, including Cricket, X01 and Around the World.

Play in one of five beautifully designed, AAA-quality rooms including The  Black Hat Tavern and Tournament Arena.

Challenge friends worldwide and show off your customized darts with a variety of tips, barrels, shafts, and flights to choose from. Earn achievements and climb the global leaderboards.

nodes.long_description:
On Target VR Darts for Quest (App Lab)

On Target VR Darts is a realistic darts simulation. If you like competitive darts, this is the game for you. Play Cricket, 501, 301 and Around the world vs AI. Get the hang of things in Freethrow, or warm up in a quick round of Speed Darts. Gain achievements, fully customize your darts, play in three high quality environments and challenge players from around the world for top spot on our Leaderboards. 

Multiplayer integration is currently in development.

We'll be adding additional stats and Leaderboards, Single and Multiplayer Tournament modes, and custom home items soon.

Looking forward to hearing your thoughts about the game! Reviews really help small Indie Developers like us make better games.

nodes.change_log:
v1.9.1

- New: Cross-play with Steam - Meta Quest and SteamVR players can now play online together in the same games. Steam players appear as Meta avatars matched to the character they picked.
- New: Name tags above every player online, with their name and profile picture. Tags always turn to face you.
- New: Online session list shows when a game is hosted on the other platform, e.g. "(Steam)".
- New: Tournament - work your way through a bracket of AI opponents in Single Player.
- New: AI opponents in the room - in every Single Player game against the AI, tournaments included, your opponent stands at the line and throws its own darts, taking turns with you.
- New: Dart Grip - put your other hand on the white sphere above the dart and hold the grip button to move and turn it.
- Improved: Messages below the board have a cleaner, rounded look.
- Fix: Online - voice chat now starts reliably on Quest.
- Fix: Online - when a player leaves, their avatar and name tag disappear right away instead of staying behind.

v1.8.16 (November 8, 2026)
- Major Improvement: Controllers - reworked dart release, in Single Player and Online. The dart now leaves your hand the moment you ease off the trigger, instead of waiting until the trigger is almost fully released. Throw speed and direction now come from the peak of your throw, so holding on a touch too long no longer pulls the dart low, and every throw is far more consistent. The dart still only leaves when you let go of the trigger, so practice swings work as before.
- Note: Throwing will feel different after this update, and throws may land higher than you're used to. You may need to adjust Throw Power and Dart Weight in Settings to get the right feel again.
- New: X01 - Bust, Need a double to finish and Need a double to start now show below the board, for every player online.
- New: X01 - your Double-In and Double-Out choices are now remembered.
- Fix: Online X01 - turning Double-Out off now works, so you can finish on a single.
- Fix: X01 - the AI now finishes the game with Double-Out off, and no longer throws an extra dart after it wins.
- Fix: Cricket - points now show on the scoreboard right away, with no more floating "0".
- Fix: Online Around the World - every player starts on 1, everyone sees each player's progress and next target, and the match now has its own end screen and leaderboard.
- Fix: Online X01 - leaderboard wins and achievements now count when the match is won, not after every leg.
- Fix: Online - in 3 and 4 player games, only the winner gets the win, and your first online win is now recorded.
- Fix: A bust no longer counts an extra dart, and the "Play 301" achievement now unlocks against the AI.

v1.8.15 (November 6, 2026)
- New: A new loading spinner between scenes.
- Improved: Online - sharper picture. Multiplayer now renders at full resolution, the same as Single Player.
- Fix: Online - when the other player leaves mid-match, the host now stays in the session with the player list, instead of a blank screen.
- Fix: Online - players whose Meta avatar can't load now get a default avatar.

v1.8.14 (November 5, 2026)
- New: Hands and controllers now work together in Single Player. Put both controllers down to play with your hands, or pick them up to switch back, at any time. Hands Mode no longer has its own separate scenes.
- New: Dart Grip (Settings - Extra). Adjust the position and rotation of the dart in your hand. Each hand keeps its own grip for controllers, the Hands character and hand tracking.
- New: Hand Pose (Settings - Extra). While holding a dart with a controller, tap a finger joint with your other index finger and adjust it to shape your grip, for the Avatar and Hands characters.
- New: Character setting (Settings - Extra). Show your avatar, floating hands, or nothing in the Passthrough scene.
- New: Hands Mode - the dart turns amber, then red, when you pull it too close to your face, where hand tracking can drop.
- New: Throw Power and Dart Weight now show whether they apply to hands or controllers.
- New: The lobby now works with hand tracking, and you face the board on first launch.
- Improved: Engine update, including security fixes.
- Improved: Hands Mode throws now let go at the peak of your flick, even if tracking misses your fingers opening, for a cleaner flight to the board.
- Improved: Hands Mode darts fly straighter, with much less sideways turn and twist on release.
- Improved: Hands Mode - a dart you're holding still stays in place if hand tracking drops, instead of falling.
- Improved: Hands Mode has new defaults: Throw Power 7.5 and 20g. Dart grips and hand poses have new defaults too.
- Improved: Avatar fingers follow your tracked hands more closely, and the dark default avatar no longer shows while yours loads.
- Fix: Lifetime darts thrown stopped counting up between scenes, which also held back the throw achievements.
- Fix: Hit dot and its shadow were not showing on the board in some cases.
- Fix: Dart Cam no longer zooms from the trigger and grip while a menu is open.
- Fix: The hand pointer no longer shows in the Dart Cam, and is smaller.

v1.8.11 (October 29, 2026)
- New: Dart Cam now follows other players' darts in Online games.
- New: Online - every player's Meta profile icon now shows in the player list.
- New: Hands Mode has its own Throw Power and Dart Weight settings, separate from controllers (defaults: 8 and 15g).
- New: Dart weight now affects throw speed with controllers (10g throws faster, 50g throws slower).
- Improved: Dart Cam performance. It only updates while moving, which gives smoother frame rates.
- Improved: Hands Mode throws keep the speed and direction of your flick, so darts no longer stall in your hand or drop short.
- Improved: Hands Mode - you can open the wrist menu with your right hand while your left hand holds a dart.
- Improved: Smoother frame rates, with less logging and fewer settings saves during play.
- Improved: Rewrote the translations for every supported language, including menus, rules, the darts glossary and this changelog. Many more menu and lobby texts are now translated.
- Fix: Hands Mode Customize menu was hidden behind the Main Menu. Back now returns to the previous menu.
- Fix: Hands Mode wrist-pinch menu could open while holding a dart, flicker, or close the lobby and end-game menus.
- Fix: Hands Mode throws could be too strong from tracking spikes or the controller Throw Power setting.
- Fix: New installs default to right-hand throwing, and Settings no longer overrides the hand chosen during onboarding.
- Fix: Menu Back button could get stuck with nowhere to go.
- Fix: Cricket end-game Exit to Main button did nothing.
- Fix: An error could appear when quitting the game.
- Fix: Missing characters no longer show as empty boxes in Japanese, Korean and Chinese, and accented letters now use the game's font.
- Fix: Online - remote players' misses were not counted on the scoreboard.
- Fix: Online - a bust on the last dart could skip the next player's turn.
- Fix: Online - Play Again could get stuck in a loop.
- Fix: Online - first player sometimes received two sets of darts at game start.
- Fix: Online - darts could stop appearing after an interrupted spawn.
- Fix: Online - darts-thrown count now matches on every player's scoreboard.
- Fix: Online - player numbers were wrong when spectators were in the session.
- Fix: Online - Cricket now scores, closes numbers and picks the winner correctly in 3 and 4 player games.
- Fix: Online - end-game screen now shows Player 3 and Player 4 names and scores, and the X01 end-game buttons in 3 and 4 player games.
- Fix: Online - players leaving mid-game no longer stall the match. If the host leaves at any time, even in the waiting room, everyone returns safely to the Main Menu.
- Fix: Online - Exit to Main now properly leaves the session for players who joined.
- Fix: Online - turns now end as soon as the last dart scores, and late dart results no longer change the score.
- Fix: Online - old player list no longer shows after leaving a session.
- Fix: Online - player names now show in the player list as each player joins, not just at game start.
- Fix: Online - long player names were cut off.
- Fix: Online - a slow third dart could show up in the first dart's slot on the scoreboard.
- Fix: Online - the turn marker never moved to Player 3.

v1.8.10 (May 26, 2026)
- Fix: Bullseye (25) issue and outer miss areas did not report a score and darts sink too far in to the board. This was a physics issue, problem solved.
- Fix: Cricket AI Opponent won't throw darts when it's their turn.
- Fix: Moving the Dartcam moves the AI dart on the 3rd throw.
